summary: Design, govern, fund, and measure a corporate academy with practical tools and templates. Build your academy blueprint with TrainingCred.
lede: Corporate learning academy design and governance helps you connect workforce capability with business priorities, compliance obligations, and digital transformation. This course guides you in building a capability taxonomy, mapping roles to learning pathways, and creating a governed operating model with clear ownership and measurable outcomes. Using ISO 10015:2019, ISO 30422:2022, the Kirkpatrick evaluation model, the Phillips ROI methodology, and the ADDIE model as practical reference points, you will develop a capability heat map, learning portfolio, governance matrix, vendor scorecard, funding model, and impact dashboard. You will also address supplier quality, manager sponsorship, uneven data, procurement constraints, and phased implementation through practical academy design work.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for converting workforce priorities into governed learning academies, role-based pathways, and evidence-led capability investments.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in HR, L&D, talent development, workforce planning, transformation, procurement, or programme operations. No coding or programming is required. Basic familiarity with spreadsheets, learning records, organizational strategy, and budget discussions will help you complete the practical exercises. Advanced learning technology architecture and complex ROI attribution receive conceptual or operational coverage rather than technical engineering treatment.
